title: Cash and crypto OTC — account cashing-out (demo script)
summary: Synthetic training case. A salaried customer's account collects many credits. The money then leaves through cash withdrawals and transfers to an OTC crypto dealer. The customer cannot give a source of funds that matches the file. The trainee decides on enhanced due diligence, a suspicious transaction report, a freeze recommendation or exiting the relationship. Inspired by a public summary of local account cashing-out. Not a real customer file.

teaching.disclaimer: Synthetic training scenario inspired by public enforcement reporting. Not official case files; no real customer data.

sources.label: Public enforcement briefing, JUSTICEGATE (October 2022–June 2023; URL not in the course brief)

rules.when: The customer cannot give a source of funds that matches the file
rules.note: A friend's currency exchange is not proof of source. Do not close the case while the source is blank.

rules.when: The credits mainly leave through cash withdrawals plus an OTC crypto dealer
rules.note: Do not close it as personal investment. Rules come before any model score.

nodes.title: Salaried profile against large flows in and out
nodes.prompt: Synthetic Customer D is on file as a salaried person. Over several months the account collects many credits. The outflows start to show cash withdrawals and transfers to the OTC crypto dealer SYN-OTC-JG-07.

nodes.title: Ask for the source first?
nodes.prompt: The amounts do not match the salaried profile. Do you ask for the source of funds and run enhanced due diligence, hold outbound payments first, or note it as investment and close it?

choices.label: Ask for the source of funds and run enhanced due diligence
choices.rationale: Get the source first, then let R1 decide whether the case can close.

choices.label: Hold outbound payments first, then ask for the source
choices.rationale: Stopping payments and gathering evidence can happen at the same time.

choices.label: Note it as investment and close
choices.rationale: A poor teaching start. The source is still blank, and the cash and OTC path will trigger R2.

nodes.title: No matching source
nodes.prompt: The customer only says a friend exchanged currency, and cannot produce proof that matches the salaried profile. Rule R1: a blank source must not be closed.

nodes.title: After a blank source
nodes.prompt: R1 is met. Do you keep the hold and look at where the money goes, draft a suspicious transaction report now, or accept the friend's currency exchange?

choices.label: Keep the hold and check where the money goes
choices.rationale: Matches R1. Do not release yet.

choices.label: Draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: The source already does not match the file. You can report.

choices.label: Accept the friend's currency exchange
choices.rationale: Overrides R1. The blank source has not become proof.

nodes.title: Cash and the OTC dealer
nodes.prompt: Two transfers go to the synthetic OTC dealer SYN-OTC-JG-07, and the rest is withdrawn in cash. Rule R2: when cash plus OTC crypto is the main outflow, the case must not be closed as investment.

nodes.title: Handling the cash-out path
nodes.prompt: R2 is met. Do you recommend a freeze and report, exit the relationship, or close it as investment?

choices.label: Recommend a freeze and draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: The stop-and-report exit that matches R2.

choices.label: Exit the customer relationship
choices.rationale: The exit-the-relationship route that matches R2.

choices.label: Close as personal investment
choices.rationale: Poor teaching path. The rules already say the case must not be closed this way.

nodes.title: Suspicious transaction report drafted
nodes.prompt: Reporting exit. The source of funds is still unproven and stays in the state.

nodes.title: Freeze recommended and report drafted
nodes.prompt: Outbound payments are on hold and the report is drafted. The OTC counterparty SYN-OTC-JG-07 is still in the state.

nodes.title: Customer relationship exited
nodes.prompt: The relationship has ended. The flags for the cash and OTC outflows stay in the twin state.

nodes.title: Closed as investment
nodes.prompt: Poor teaching path. R2 was ignored. The dashboard should later mark this session as not following the rules.
